<!doctype html>
<html lang="id"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>KKMP Pontianak — Sistem Prioritas TPS dan Rute Armada</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#17365d;--blue:#1677b8;--green:#149b78;--orange:#e87522;--red:#e53935;
--bg:#f3f6fa;--card:#fff;--text:#172033;--muted:#4b5a70;--line:#e1e7ef;--soft:#eef3f9;--field:#fff;--fieldline:#c9d2df;--warnbg:#fff5df;--mapbg:#dfe6ee;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0f1622;--card:#182233;--text:#e6ecf5;--muted:#a3b1c6;--line:#2a3a52;--soft:#1f2d44;--field:#1f2d44;--fieldline:#3a4c68;--warnbg:#3a2f16;--mapbg:#26324a}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0f1622;--card:#182233;--text:#e6ecf5;--muted:#a3b1c6;--line:#2a3a52;--soft:#1f2d44;--field:#1f2d44;--fieldline:#3a4c68;--warnbg:#3a2f16;--mapbg:#26324a}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text)}
header{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:16px 22px}
header h1{font-size:21px;margin:0 0 5px}header p{margin:0;font-size:13px;opacity:.92}
.badge{display:inline-block;background:#e9a23b;color:#2b1d00;font-weight:700;font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;margin-bottom:8px}
main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:350px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:14px;height:calc(100vh - 118px);min-height:560px;box-sizing:border-box}
aside,.mapwrap{background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0002;overflow:auto;min-width:0}
aside{padding:16px}
h2{font-size:13px;margin:18px 0 8px;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) h2{color:#8ec5f0}}
label{font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
select,input[type=search]{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--fieldline);border-radius:7px;background:var(--field);color:var(--text);font-size:14px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:12px 0}
.kpi{background:var(--soft);border-radius:8px;padding:10px}.kpi strong{display:block;font-size:21px}.kpi span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11.5px}th,td{padding:5px 4px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}th:first-child,td:first-child{text-align:left}tr.cur td{background:var(--soft);font-weight:700}
.tbl{overflow-x:auto}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 12px;font-size:12px}.chips label{font-weight:400;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%}
.list{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;max-height:210px;overflow:auto}
.row{padding:6px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px}.row:hover,.row:focus{background:var(--soft);outline:none}
.note{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted)}
.warning{background:var(--warnbg);border-left:4px solid #e9a23b;padding:10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:14px;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0}
button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid var(--fieldline);background:var(--field);color:var(--text);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
#tilewarn{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
#map{height:100%;min-height:440px;background:var(--mapbg)}
footer{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:860px){main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:auto}#map{height:68vh}.mapwrap{order:-1}}
/* Gaya minimum Leaflet (disisipkan langsung karena stylesheet eksternal tidak dimuat di halaman terbit) */
.leaflet-pane,.leaflet-tile,.leaflet-marker-icon,.leaflet-tile-container,.leaflet-pane>svg,.leaflet-pane>canvas,.leaflet-zoom-box,.leaflet-layer{position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
.leaflet-container{overflow:hidden;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;font:12px/1.5 system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.leaflet-tile,.leaflet-marker-icon{user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.leaflet-tile{visibility:hidden}.leaflet-tile-loaded{visibility:inherit}
.leaflet-container img.leaflet-tile{max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important}
.leaflet-map-pane svg,.leaflet-map-pane canvas{max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important}
.leaflet-zoom-box{box-sizing:border-box;z-index:800}
.leaflet-pane{z-index:400}.leaflet-tile-pane{z-index:200}.leaflet-overlay-pane{z-index:400}.leaflet-shadow-pane{z-index:500}.leaflet-marker-pane{z-index:600}.leaflet-tooltip-pane{z-index:650}.leaflet-popup-pane{z-index:700}
.leaflet-zoom-animated{transform-origin:0 0}
.leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-zoom-animated{transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(0,0,.25,1)}
.leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-tile,.leaflet-pan-anim .leaflet-tile{transition:none}
.leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-zoom-hide{visibility:hidden}
.leaflet-interactive{cursor:pointer}.leaflet-grab{cursor:grab}.leaflet-dragging .leaflet-grab{cursor:move}
.leaflet-pane>svg path.leaflet-interactive{pointer-events:auto}
.leaflet-control{position:relative;z-index:800;pointer-events:auto;float:left;clear:both}
.leaflet-top,.leaflet-bottom{position:absolute;z-index:1000;pointer-events:none}
.leaflet-top{top:0}.leaflet-bottom{bottom:0}.leaflet-left{left:0}.leaflet-right{right:0}
.leaflet-right .leaflet-control{float:right;margin-right:10px}.leaflet-left .leaflet-control{margin-left:10px}
.leaflet-top .leaflet-control{margin-top:10px}.leaflet-bottom .leaflet-control{margin-bottom:10px}
.leaflet-bar{box-shadow:0 1px 5px #0006;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.leaflet-bar a{display:block;width:30px;height:30px;line-height:30px;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;background:#fff;color:#222;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;font:bold 18px/30px Arial,sans-serif}
.leaflet-bar a:last-child{border-bottom:0}.leaflet-bar a.leaflet-disabled{color:#bbb;cursor:default}
.leaflet-control-attribution{background:#fffc;padding:0 5px;font-size:11px;color:#333}.leaflet-control-attribution a{color:#0078a8}
.leaflet-popup{position:absolute;text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.leaflet-popup-content-wrapper{padding:1px;text-align:left;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#222;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #0006}
.leaflet-popup-content{margin:12px 22px 12px 16px;line-height:1.45;font-size:13px}
.leaflet-popup-tip-container{width:40px;height:20px;position:absolute;left:50%;margin-left:-20px;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.leaflet-popup-tip{width:17px;height:17px;padding:1px;margin:-10px auto 0;transform:rotate(45deg);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #0006}
.leaflet-container a.leaflet-popup-close-button{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;padding:4px 6px 0 0;font:18px/14px Arial,sans-serif;color:#757575;text-decoration:none}
</style></head><body>
<header><span class="badge">PROTOTIPE LOMBA ESAI · DATA SIMULASI/ASUMSI</span>
<h1>KKMP Pontianak — Skenario, Prioritas TPS dan Rute Armada</h1>
<p>Prototipe terpadu untuk demonstrasi. Lokasi dan jaringan jalan berasal dari berkas tim; skor, volume, dan jadwal adalah asumsi simulasi.</p></header>
<main><aside>
<label for="scenario">Pilih skenario</label>
<select id="scenario"><option value="LONJAKAN_TINGGI">Lonjakan tinggi (+40%, stress test)</option><option value="MUSIM_BUAH">Musim buah (+20%, stress test)</option><option value="NORMAL">Normal (baseline)</option></select>
<div class="kpis">
<div class="kpi"><strong id="n-tps">–</strong><span>TPS terdata</span></div><div class="kpi"><strong id="n-high">–</strong><span>Prioritas tinggi</span></div>
<div class="kpi"><strong id="n-med">–</strong><span>Prioritas sedang</span></div><div class="kpi"><strong id="n-trucks">–</strong><span>Truk bertugas / 36</span></div>
<div class="kpi"><strong id="km">–</strong><span>Total panjang rute simulasi</span></div><div class="kpi"><strong id="n-spare">–</strong><span>Truk cadangan</span></div>
</div>

<h2>Perbandingan skenario</h2>
<div class="tbl"><table id="cmp"></table></div>

<h2>Filter peta</h2>
<div class="chips" id="f-depo"></div>
<div class="chips" id="f-level" style="margin-top:8px"></div>
<div class="btns"><button id="b-tiles" type="button">Sembunyikan peta dasar</button><button id="b-reset" type="button">Reset tampilan</button><button id="b-theme" type="button">Ganti tema</button></div>
<div id="tilewarn" hidden>Peta dasar tidak dapat dimuat di halaman ini, tetapi titik dan rute tetap tampil.</div>

<h2>Cari TPS</h2>
<input id="q" type="search" list="tps-names" placeholder="Ketik nama TPS lalu tekan Enter" aria-label="Cari TPS"><datalist id="tps-names"></datalist>

<h2>Peringkat TPS (skor proxy)</h2>
<div id="rank" class="list"></div>

<h2>Rute kendaraan</h2>
<p class="note">Klik baris untuk memperbesar rute di peta.</p>
<div id="route-list" class="list"></div>

<h2>Legenda</h2>
<div class="chips"><span><i class="dot" style="background:#e53935"></i> TPS tinggi</span><span><i class="dot" style="background:#f39c12"></i> TPS sedang</span><span><i class="dot" style="background:#27ae60"></i> TPS rendah</span><span><i class="dot" style="background:#00c3e0"></i> Depo</span><span><i class="dot" style="background:#111"></i> TPA</span></div>
<p class="note">Warna garis rute membedakan depo: DEP-1 biru, DEP-2 hijau, DEP-3 oranye.</p>

<div class="warning"><b>Batas penggunaan:</b> skor memakai proxy dan asumsi, bukan volume aktual TPS. Rute adalah heuristik jalur terpendek pada jaringan jalan; belum memodelkan kemacetan, arah satu jalan, larangan truk, kapasitas TPS, atau biaya. Jam dan waktu layanan juga asumsi simulasi. Hasil ini untuk menggambarkan konsep, bukan dasar keputusan operasional.</div>
<footer>Seluruh skenario sudah dihitung sebelumnya; ubah pilihan skenario untuk membandingkan peta. Peta dasar © OpenStreetMap.</footer>
</aside><section class="mapwrap"><div id="map"></div></section></main>

2","Depo_ID":"DEP-3","Snap_m":19.0},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[109.294566,0.010538999999999998]}}]};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const fmt=n=>Number(n||0).toLocaleString('id-ID',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
const SCEN={NORMAL:'Normal',MUSIM_BUAH:'Musim buah',LONJAKAN_TINGGI:'Lonjakan tinggi'};
const DEPOT_COLOR={'DEP-1':'#1677b8','DEP-2':'#149b78','DEP-3':'#e87522'};
const LEVEL_COLOR={TINGGI:'#e53935',SEDANG:'#f39c12',RENDAH:'#27ae60'};
const TOTAL_TRUCKS=36, HOME=[[-0.025,109.34],12];
const hiddenDepo=new Set(), hiddenLevel=new Set();
let routeLayer, pointLayer, routeById={}, markerByName={};

const map=L.map('map').setView(HOME[0],HOME[1]);
map.attributionControl.setPrefix(false);
const tiles=L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',{maxZoom:19,attribution:'© OpenStreetMap'}).addTo(map);
tiles.on('tileerror',()=>{$('tilewarn').hidden=false});

const inScenario=(fc,sc)=>fc.features.filter(f=>f.properties.Skenario===sc);
function stats(sc){
  const r=inScenario(ROUTES,sc), t=inScenario(POINTS,sc).filter(f=>f.properties.Jenis==='TPS');
  const n=l=>t.filter(f=>f.properties.Level===l).length;
  return {tps:t.length,high:n('TINGGI'),med:n('SEDANG'),trucks:r.length,km:r.reduce((s,f)=>s+Number(f.properties.Jarak_rute_km||0),0)};
}

function renderComparison(sc){
  let h='<tr><th>Skenario</th><th>Tinggi</th><th>Sedang</th><th>Truk</th><th>Km</th></tr>';
  Object.keys(SCEN).forEach(k=>{const s=stats(k);h+=`<tr class="${k===sc?'cur':''}"><td>${SCEN[k]}</td><td>${s.high}</td><td>${s.med}</td><td>${s.trucks}</td><td>${fmt(s.km)}</td></tr>`});
  $('cmp').innerHTML=h;
}

function popupRoute(p){return `<b>${esc(p.Truk_ID)}</b><br>${esc(p.Nama_Depo)}<br>TPS: ${esc(p.Urutan_TPS||'-')}<br>Jarak rute: ${fmt(p.Jarak_rute_km)} km<br>Jumlah TPS: ${esc(p.Jumlah_TPS)}`}
function popupPoint(p){return `<b>${esc(p.Nama_Lokasi)}</b><br>Jenis: ${esc(p.Jenis)}<br>Kelurahan: ${esc(p.Kelurahan||'-')}<br>Skor proxy: ${esc(p.Skor)}<br>Prioritas: ${esc(p.Level)}<br>Aksi: ${esc(p.Aksi)}<br>Snap ke jalan: ${esc(p.Snap_m)} m`}

function render(){
  const sc=$('scenario').value;
  [routeLayer,pointLayer].forEach(l=>l&&map.removeLayer(l));
  routeById={};markerByName={};
  const allR=inScenario(ROUTES,sc), allP=inScenario(POINTS,sc);
  const showR=allR.filter(f=>!hiddenDepo.has(f.properties.Depo_ID));
  const showP=allP.filter(f=>{const p=f.properties;
    if(p.Jenis==='TPS')return !hiddenLevel.has(p.Level)&&!hiddenDepo.has(p.Depo_ID);
    if(p.Jenis==='DEPO')return !hiddenDepo.has(p.Depo_ID);
    return true;});

  routeLayer=L.geoJSON({type:'FeatureCollection',features:showR},{
    style:f=>({color:DEPOT_COLOR[f.properties.Depo_ID]||'#555',weight:3,opacity:.8}),
    onEachFeature:(f,l)=>{l.bindPopup(popupRoute(f.properties));routeById[f.properties.Truk_ID]=l}
  }).addTo(map);
  pointLayer=L.geoJSON({type:'FeatureCollection',features:showP},{
    pointToLayer:(f,ll)=>{const p=f.properties,c=p.Jenis==='TPA'?'#111':p.Jenis==='DEPO'?'#00c3e0':(LEVEL_COLOR[p.Level]||'#777');
      return L.circleMarker(ll,{radius:p.Jenis==='TPA'?9:p.Jenis==='DEPO'?8:6,color:p.Jenis==='DEPO'?'#00a6c7':c,fillColor:c,weight:1.5,fillOpacity:.9})},
    onEachFeature:(f,l)=>{l.bindPopup(popupPoint(f.properties));markerByName[f.properties.Nama_Lokasi]=l}
  }).addTo(map);

  const s=stats(sc);
  $('n-tps').textContent=s.tps;$('n-high').textContent=s.high;$('n-med').textContent=s.med;
  $('n-trucks').textContent=s.trucks;$('n-spare').textContent=TOTAL_TRUCKS-s.trucks;$('km').textContent=fmt(s.km)+' km';
  renderComparison(sc);

  const tps=allP.filter(f=>f.properties.Jenis==='TPS').map(f=>f.properties).sort((a,b)=>b.Skor-a.Skor);
  $('tps-names').innerHTML=tps.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.Nama_Lokasi)}">`).join('');
  $('rank').innerHTML=tps.slice(0,10).map((p,i)=>`<div class="row" tabindex="0" data-pt="${esc(p.Nama_Lokasi)}">${i+1}. <b>${esc(p.Nama_Lokasi)}</b> · skor ${esc(p.Skor)} · ${esc(p.Level)}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="note">Tidak ada data.</div>';
  $('route-list').innerHTML=allR.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.properties.Truk_ID.localeCompare(b.properties.Truk_ID)).map(f=>{const p=f.properties;
    return `<div class="row" tabindex="0" data-rt="${esc(p.Truk_ID)}"><b>${esc(p.Truk_ID)}</b> · ${esc(p.Depo_ID)} · ${fmt(p.Jarak_rute_km)} km<br>${esc(p.Urutan_TPS||'Cadangan')}</div>`}).join('');
  if(showR.length)map.fitBounds(routeLayer.getBounds().pad(.08));else map.setView(HOME[0],HOME[1]);
}

function focusPoint(name){const m=markerByName[name];if(!m)return false;map.setView(m.getLatLng(),16);m.openPopup();return true}
function focusRoute(id){const l=routeById[id];if(!l)return;map.fitBounds(l.getBounds().pad(.1));l.openPopup(l.getBounds().getCenter())}
function activate(e){const r=e.target.closest('.row');if(!r)return;
  if(r.dataset.pt)focusPoint(r.dataset.pt);else if(r.dataset.rt)focusRoute(r.dataset.rt);
  if(window.innerWidth<=860)$('map').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})}
['rank','route-list'].forEach(id=>{$(id).addEventListener('click',activate);$(id).addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')activate(e)})});

function buildFilters(){
  const mk=(box,items,set,colorOf)=>{$(box).innerHTML=items.map(k=>`<label><input type="checkbox" checked data-k="${k}"><i class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(k)}"></i>${k}</label>`).join('');
    $(box).addEventListener('change',e=>{const k=e.target.dataset.k;e.target.checked?set.delete(k):set.add(k);render()})};
  mk('f-depo',Object.keys(DEPOT_COLOR),hiddenDepo,k=>DEPOT_COLOR[k]);
  mk('f-level',Object.keys(LEVEL_COLOR),hiddenLevel,k=>LEVEL_COLOR[k]);
}
$('q').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key!=='Enter')return;
  const v=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();if(!v)return;
  const hit=Object.keys(markerByName).find(n=>n.toLowerCase()===v)||Object.keys(markerByName).find(n=>n.toLowerCase().includes(v));
  if(!hit||!focusPoint(hit))e.target.setCustomValidity('TPS tidak ditemukan');else e.target.setCustomValidity('')});
$('b-tiles').addEventListener('click',e=>{const on=map.hasLayer(tiles);on?map.removeLayer(tiles):tiles.addTo(map);e.target.textContent=on?'Tampilkan peta dasar':'Sembunyikan peta dasar'});
$('b-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{hiddenDepo.clear();hiddenLevel.clear();document.querySelectorAll('.chips input').forEach(i=>i.checked=true);$('q').value='';render()});
$('b-theme').addEventListener('click',()=>{const d=document.documentElement,dark=d.dataset.theme?d.dataset.theme==='dark':matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;d.dataset.theme=dark?'light':'dark'});
$('scenario').addEventListener('change',render);
buildFilters();render();
</script></body></html>
